reason: planning stopped before any code was written: the plan still needed revising in the last round (round 5 of 5). I read surveys.rs, verify.rs, checks.rs, replay.rs, run/mod.rs, both record enums, the reader guide and its briefs tests, and the athena-cli entry points. Most of the plan matches the code. The helpers it names exist at the cited lines: code_surveys, names_record_evidence, changes_code_with_behavior_criterion, existing_code_assumptions, and split_clauses, clause_words and is_negator in verify.rs. AnyRecord and HistoryRecord are both `#[serde(tag = "schema")]` with the tag lists the plan describes. CODE_SURVEY_GUIDE is public in athena-context. INPUT_FORMS has length 63, and the section bounds are 3045 and 3150. One finding is major. The dependents list leaves out the `athena check-reading` command in athena-cli/src/main.rs (check_reading_command and its tests). That command calls check_reading_text, and the refusal-rule replay runs it on both builds (replay.rs:112), so criterion 4 depends on it. The other findings are minor. The plan says no step can measure the real replay share, but the in-loop replay (run/mod.rs:2275-2334) measures it during the producer run and sends it back, and the plan does not tell the producer what to do then. The skip-switch and internal-helper rule only catches readings that use those literal English words. The rule asks for a `Direct check:` clause even on routine criteria such as 'fmt, clippy and test pass'. The verdict is revise, because the major finding needs only a dependents entry and a test command. Findings: minor: crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs is not among the reading's deliverables (files, crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs); major: The dependents list leaves out the `athena check-reading` command, which calls check_reading_text and is the binary the replay runs. (Dependents: 'reading acceptance gate order' entry; crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs:683-712 and the tests at 1265-1425); minor: The plan says no step can measure the real newly refused share, but the in-loop replay measures it during the producer run and sends it back. The plan does not say what the producer does with that result. (Risks, first item; Decision 11; Step 10); minor: The skip-switch and internal-helper check only catches readings that use those literal English words. A real skip switch or helper read written as an identifier passes. (Decision 9; Criterion 3 demonstration); minor: The rule asks for a `Direct check:` clause for every behavior criterion, including routine ones such as 'fmt, clippy and test pass', which forces boilerplate. (Decision 8); nit: The record-tag probe parses serde's error text even though the enums already have schema accessors. (Decision 7)
